1e41715c6887a78b87e8818d0931132d.name: Block
1e41715c6887a78b87e8818d0931132d.en: The commonest still life and the most frequent result of two-glider collisions (six ways). It also acts as a catalyst, e.g. erasing the beehive left by a queen bee shuttle or a developing honey farm.
1e41715c6887a78b87e8818d0931132d.pt: A vida estática mais comum e o resultado mais frequente de colisões entre dois planadores (de seis maneiras). Também atua como catalisador, por exemplo apagando a colmeia deixada por um queen bee shuttle.

3827ab7254af606a4f554e4556a6a3d1.name: Infinite growth
3827ab7254af606a4f554e4556a6a3d1.en: No other pattern small enough for a 5x5 box grows forever; this seed's population keeps climbing without limit.
3827ab7254af606a4f554e4556a6a3d1.pt: Nenhum outro padrão que caiba numa caixa 5x5 cresce para sempre: a população desta semente aumenta sem limite.

2b2c5cb29bc7bc0dbe28c214013c744b.name: Pulsar
2b2c5cb29bc7bc0dbe28c214013c744b.en: Big as it is, it ranks fourth among the most frequent oscillators and is by far the commonest with a period over 2. Conway found it very early on.
2b2c5cb29bc7bc0dbe28c214013c744b.pt: Apesar do tamanho, é o quarto oscilador mais frequente e, de longe, o mais comum entre os de período maior que 2. Conway o encontrou bem no começo.

0c5ba29aa563a5f00f9b68cf6e01539c.name: Alternate eater 5
0c5ba29aa563a5f00f9b68cf6e01539c.en: A version of eater 5 in which a long hook with tail stands in for the usual block.
0c5ba29aa563a5f00f9b68cf6e01539c.pt: Versão do comedor eater 5 em que um long hook with tail ocupa o lugar do bloco habitual.

16c25b309a52f809355cfd43943169e4.name: Beehive bend tail
16c25b309a52f809355cfd43943169e4.en: Also known as beehive with hooked tail.
16c25b309a52f809355cfd43943169e4.pt: Também conhecida como beehive with hooked tail.

14241843ab0f08e5edcc2c99dbcb57a0.name: Bi-loaf
14241843ab0f08e5edcc2c99dbcb57a0.en: Makes up one half of a bakery, hence its alias halfbakery. The name bi-loaf has also been given to a rarer still life and to a pure glider generator.
14241843ab0f08e5edcc2c99dbcb57a0.pt: Forma metade de uma bakery, daí o apelido halfbakery. O nome bi-loaf também já designou uma vida estática mais rara e um gerador puro de planadores.

226a3c6d65dbea00337bb1576bb3470f.name: Brokensnake
226a3c6d65dbea00337bb1576bb3470f.en: An aircraft carrier fused to a snake, which is why it also goes by carrier siamese snake.
226a3c6d65dbea00337bb1576bb3470f.pt: Um aircraft carrier fundido a uma snake; por isso também é chamado de carrier siamese snake.

030bfc0c1dc111f1ab3514562d160771.name: Cismirroredbun
030bfc0c1dc111f1ab3514562d160771.en: Two buns placed face to face; it is also known as cis-mirrored R-bee.
030bfc0c1dc111f1ab3514562d160771.pt: Dois buns colocados frente a frente; também é conhecido como cis-mirrored R-bee.

340b35e56210ca289c06f8a6c67b7aff.name: Dead spark coil
340b35e56210ca289c06f8a6c67b7aff.en: Its name refers to the spark coil, and the Life Lexicon invites comparing the two.
340b35e56210ca289c06f8a6c67b7aff.pt: O nome faz referência ao spark coil, e o Life Lexicon sugere comparar os dois.

018ef73ce1c15a2318d7980041c16bcc.name: Loaf tie eater-with-tail
018ef73ce1c15a2318d7980041c16bcc.en: A loaf tied to an eater with tail; among 18-cell still lifes that arise naturally, it is the third most frequent.
018ef73ce1c15a2318d7980041c16bcc.pt: Um loaf ligado a um eater with tail; entre as vidas estáticas de 18 células que surgem naturalmente, é a terceira mais comum.

311ce51a315a3e62cf9435db3d513fa4.name: Mango
311ce51a315a3e62cf9435db3d513fa4.en: It is unchanged by a half-turn rotation, and one appears in the ash that the acorn eventually leaves.
311ce51a315a3e62cf9435db3d513fa4.pt: Não muda com uma rotação de meia-volta, e um mango aparece entre os detritos que o acorn acaba deixando.

001f583f00b8162a4e97a0f8c03f30eb.name: Python siamese snake
001f583f00b8162a4e97a0f8c03f30eb.en: Also known as snake siamese long snake.
001f583f00b8162a4e97a0f8c03f30eb.pt: Também conhecida como snake siamese long snake.

05c8988c3b3a7ec5a04c9650aa51fa41.name: Transmirroredbun
05c8988c3b3a7ec5a04c9650aa51fa41.en: Made of two buns turned toward each other; another name for it is trans-mirrored R-bee.
05c8988c3b3a7ec5a04c9650aa51fa41.pt: Formado por dois buns voltados um para o outro; outro nome para ele é trans-mirrored R-bee.

30c312246a29c0ebecb0e7c89ce35eda.name: Tubwithnine
30c312246a29c0ebecb0e7c89ce35eda.en: Also known as integral with tub.
30c312246a29c0ebecb0e7c89ce35eda.pt: Também conhecido como integral with tub.

07e62504f32e60274b8a37c1b3589938.en: Achim's p4, nicknamed dual 1-2-3-4, carries two copies of this oscillator's rotor.
07e62504f32e60274b8a37c1b3589938.pt: O Achim's p4, apelidado de dual 1-2-3-4, tem duas cópias do rotor deste oscilador.

0154b57065d00448f8f769d716400fc9.name: 144P24
0154b57065d00448f8f769d716400fc9.en: Among the earliest oscillators with period 24 ever discovered.
0154b57065d00448f8f769d716400fc9.pt: Um dos primeiros osciladores de período 24 já descobertos.

045dc248a0025c28f85a7153943d1d10.name: 36P22
045dc248a0025c28f85a7153943d1d10.en: No smaller oscillator with period 22 is known.
045dc248a0025c28f85a7153943d1d10.pt: Não se conhece oscilador de período 22 menor que este.

0095b00264329325d72261b73a34c74c.name: 400P49
0095b00264329325d72261b73a34c74c.en: A compact oscillator that relies on Noam Elkies' reflector technology.
0095b00264329325d72261b73a34c74c.pt: Um oscilador compacto que se apoia na tecnologia de refletores de Noam Elkies.

18a9b36d2fa5407003da50d519d57bf2.name: 44P7.2
18a9b36d2fa5407003da50d519d57bf2.en: Notable for supplying two domino sparks that are easy to reach.
18a9b36d2fa5407003da50d519d57bf2.pt: Destaca-se por fornecer duas faíscas de dominó de fácil acesso.

00d622b6d0a8a8abb407a3cfa2042dc7.name: 69P48
00d622b6d0a8a8abb407a3cfa2042dc7.en: No oscillator with period 48 is known to be smaller.
00d622b6d0a8a8abb407a3cfa2042dc7.pt: É o menor oscilador de período 48 conhecido.

003c7bbf926608f2ff87ad7fc2a9002e.name: 92p51
003c7bbf926608f2ff87ad7fc2a9002e.en: Holds the record as the smallest period-51 oscillator known.
003c7bbf926608f2ff87ad7fc2a9002e.pt: Detém o recorde de menor oscilador de período 51 conhecido.

03a34d50236c6f1cd154d4ed84140854.name: Beacon on 38P11.1
03a34d50236c6f1cd154d4ed84140854.en: Technically no smaller period-22 oscillator is known, but it is usually dismissed as trivial: just a period-2 beacon combined with the period-11 38P11.1.
03a34d50236c6f1cd154d4ed84140854.pt: Tecnicamente não se conhece oscilador de período 22 menor, mas ele costuma ser tido como trivial: é só um beacon (período 2) junto a um 38P11.1 (período 11).

1844a62bf86920a5281b53f5c1a7afde.name: Biting off more than they can chew

0a786cc7a3802ba80372420f69eb301a.name: Blocked p4-4
0a786cc7a3802ba80372420f69eb301a.en: Classed as a sparker, meaning an oscillator that throws off sparks.
0a786cc7a3802ba80372420f69eb301a.pt: Classificado como sparker, ou seja, um oscilador que solta faíscas.

067712cf821740fcc33de58f76614e03.name: Carnival shuttle
067712cf821740fcc33de58f76614e03.en: Wainwright's original had MW emulators at its ends; this version uses monograms in their place.
067712cf821740fcc33de58f76614e03.pt: O original de Wainwright tinha MW emulators nas pontas; esta versão usa monograms no lugar deles.

005e171b6f436a99f6fa2cfb97339fd9.name: Caterer on figure eight
005e171b6f436a99f6fa2cfb97339fd9.en: A caterer paired with a figure eight, making the smallest period-24 oscillator known.
005e171b6f436a99f6fa2cfb97339fd9.pt: Um caterer combinado com um figure eight, formando o menor oscilador de período 24 conhecido.

00ad14f7ee16b2bfaf3fb8dadc7feb29.name: David Hilbert
00ad14f7ee16b2bfaf3fb8dadc7feb29.en: Luka Okanishi finished it by building on an incomplete result from Aidan F. Pierce.
00ad14f7ee16b2bfaf3fb8dadc7feb29.pt: Luka Okanishi o completou partindo de um resultado incompleto de Aidan F. Pierce.

01df67c94cb7c9ec1824b8f5964a6798.name: Eurekaskewed
01df67c94cb7c9ec1824b8f5964a6798.en: A variation on Eureka with a skewed layout.
01df67c94cb7c9ec1824b8f5964a6798.pt: Uma variação do Eureka com disposição enviesada (skewed).

003ccda98cfcebcf8fc62f01758d4a22.name: Four eaters hassling four bookends
003ccda98cfcebcf8fc62f01758d4a22.en: Four eaters hassle four bookends here; it was found using a random agar program by Gabriel Nivasch.
003ccda98cfcebcf8fc62f01758d4a22.pt: Quatro comedores perturbam quatro bookends; foi encontrado com um programa de ágar aleatório de Gabriel Nivasch.

0022619e1094e26c00e24a96d943254a.name: Fumarole on Achim's p11
0022619e1094e26c00e24a96d943254a.en: Joins a fumarole to Achim's p11 in a compact oscillator that still counts as non-trivial.
0022619e1094e26c00e24a96d943254a.pt: Junta um fumarole ao Achim's p11 num oscilador compacto que ainda conta como não trivial.

154d697e359ef78b49148f7edf465248.name: Hexapole
154d697e359ef78b49148f7edf465248.en: It is the length-6 barberpole, which explains the 'hexa' in its name.
154d697e359ef78b49148f7edf465248.pt: É o barberpole de comprimento 6, o que explica o 'hexa' do nome.

0ca3347800fb8602fc8ff485bc7c45e7.name: Interchange
0ca3347800fb8602fc8ff485bc7c45e7.en: Six blinkers arranged in a formation that shows up often.
0ca3347800fb8602fc8ff485bc7c45e7.pt: Seis pisca-piscas dispostos numa formação que aparece com frequência.

0b5cf54e554f21f0fdce1661b5fccc53.name: Karel's p15
0b5cf54e554f21f0fdce1661b5fccc53.en: A pentadecathlon's domino spark props up a period-15 rotor here. The result offers easy-to-reach sparks, handy for nudging reactions or thinning signal streams.
0b5cf54e554f21f0fdce1661b5fccc53.pt: Aqui a faísca de dominó de um pentadecathlon sustenta um rotor de período 15. O conjunto oferece faíscas fáceis de alcançar, úteis para perturbar reações ou rarear fluxos de sinais.

00c15c7b952da9421680c22a0ddcfd5f.name: Merzenich's p64
00c15c7b952da9421680c22a0ddcfd5f.en: It emerged from a search run with Nicolay Beluchenko's randagar program.
00c15c7b952da9421680c22a0ddcfd5f.pt: Surgiu de uma busca feita com o programa randagar de Nicolay Beluchenko.

01ae6576f8fa72948848e88cad819212.name: Mold on rattlesnake
01ae6576f8fa72948848e88cad819212.en: A mold attached to a rattlesnake, together forming the smallest period-44 oscillator known.
01ae6576f8fa72948848e88cad819212.pt: Um mold acoplado a um rattlesnake, formando juntos o menor oscilador de período 44 conhecido.

00ce1c6a413246958399ccdba024354f.name: Negentropy
00ce1c6a413246958399ccdba024354f.en: Very close in form to the Hertz oscillator.
00ce1c6a413246958399ccdba024354f.pt: Tem forma muito parecida com a do Hertz oscillator.

01251bd7dde9ccf1949fd7c14e2d9399.name: p28 pre-pulsar shuttle
01251bd7dde9ccf1949fd7c14e2d9399.en: Assembled from parts found by thunk, Bill Gosper and David Buckingham.
01251bd7dde9ccf1949fd7c14e2d9399.pt: Montado com componentes descobertos por David Buckingham, Bill Gosper e thunk.
